entries.title: Proverbs 1:1
segments: The proverbs of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:2
segments: to know wisdom and instruction; to recognize the words of understanding;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:3
segments: to receive the instruction of wisdom, justice, and judgment, and uprightness;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:4
segments: to give sense to the simple, knowledge and judgment to the young man;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:5
segments: the wise hears and increases learning; and understanding ones gets wisdom;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:6
segments: to understand a proverb and its meaning; the words of the wise, and their acute sayings.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:7
segments: The fear of the LORD [is] the beginning of knowledge; but fools despise wisdom and instruction.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:8
segments: My son, hear the instruction of your father, and forsake not the law of your mother;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:9
segments: for they [shall be] an ornament of grace to your head and chains around your neck.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:10
segments: My son, if sinners lure you, do not be willing.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:11
segments: If they say, Come with us, let us lie in wait for blood, we will watch secretly for the innocent without cause;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:12
segments: let us swallow them up alive as the grave, and whole, as those who go down into the pit;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:13
segments: we shall find all precious goods; we shall fill our houses [with] plunder;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:14
segments: cast in your lot among us, and let us have one purse.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:15
segments: My son, do not walk in the way with them! Keep back your foot from their path,

entries.title: Proverbs 1:16
segments: for their feet run to evil and make haste to shed blood.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:17
segments: Surely in vain the net is spread in the sight of any bird,

entries.title: Proverbs 1:18
segments: And they lie in wait for their [own] blood; they watch secretly for their own lives.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:19
segments: So [are] the ways of everyone who gains unjust gain; it takes away its owners' life.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:20
segments: Wisdom cries outside; she utters her voice in the streets;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:21
segments: she cries in the chief place of gathering, in the openings of the gates; in the city she utters her words, [saying],

entries.title: Proverbs 1:22
segments: How long will you love simplicity, simple ones? And will scorners delight in their scorning? And will fools hate knowledge?

entries.title: Proverbs 1:23
segments: Turn at my warning; behold, I will pour out my Spirit to you; I will make my words known to you.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:24
segments: Because I called, and you refused; I stretched out my hand, and no one paid attention;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:25
segments: but you have despised all my advice, and would have none of my warning.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:26
segments: I also will laugh at your trouble; I will mock when your fear comes;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:27
segments: when your fear comes as a wasting away, and your ruin comes like a tempest when trouble and pain come upon you.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:28
segments: Then they shall call upon me, and I will not answer; they shall seek me early, but they shall not find me;

entries.title: Proverbs 1:29
segments: instead they hated knowledge and did not choose the fear of the LORD.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:30
segments: They would have none of my counsel; they despised all my correction,

entries.title: Proverbs 1:31
segments: and they shall eat the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own desires.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:32
segments: For the turning away of the simple kills them, and the ease of fools destroys them.

entries.title: Proverbs 1:33
segments: But whoever listens to me shall dwell safely, and shall be quiet from fear of evil.
